description: An attendee's RSVP for a meetup, mirrored to AT Protocol as a real org.swappulse.meetupRsvp record. References the meetup via strongRef so RSVPs are portable and verifiable across instances.

meetupRef.description: strongRef at:// URI of the meetup

meetupId.description: Local id of the Meetup for fast lookup

bringingTradeBinder.description: Whether the attendee will bring their physical binder

lookingForCards.description: Card names the attendee is hunting for

attendeeDid.description: AT Protocol DID of the attendee
